title: Editing prompts via MCP must fetch raw (resolve=false) to avoid flattening references
answers: Why did updating a prompt inline its referenced prompts?
How to edit a prompt with @@@prompt:...@@@ references via MCP
body:
Prompt content may contain `@@@prompt:...@@@` references. `llma-prompt-get` resolves them by default (returns assembled content plus `resolved_references`); stored content keeps the raw tags.
Before `llma-prompt-update`, fetch with `resolve=false` and edit that raw text. Republishing resolved content replaces references with flattened copies that stop following label moves, and `edits` 'old' text written against resolved content will not match the stored tags.
Listing: `llma-prompt-list` resolves only with `label` + `content=full`; unlabeled listings return raw tags.
Resolution is gradually rolled out: when not enabled for the team, responses return raw tags and no `resolved_references`, so content containing `@@@prompt:` should be treated as unresolved.
Guidance is documented in products/ai_observability/mcp/tools.yaml (`llma-prompt-get`, `llma-prompt-list`, `llma-prompt-update`); keep it in sync if resolution behavior changes.
applies: MCP prompt tools (llma-prompt-get/list/update) and any change to reference resolution defaults
